description: This file contains tests for the TensorFlow Go API, specifically testing graph serialization, input mapping, gradient operations, and execution of graphs within the TensorFlow library.

methods.name: hasOperations
methods.description: Checks if the specified operations are present in the graph, both directly and via its operation list.

methods.name: TestGraphWriteToAndImport
methods.description: Tests serialization of a graph and importing it with a prefix, verifying presence of operations.

methods.name: TestGraphInputMapping
methods.description: Tests importing a graph with input mapping options and running a session to verify correctness.

methods.name: TestGraphAddGradients
methods.description: Verifies gradient computation in the graph for basic operations.

methods.name: TestGraphAddGradientsSums
methods.description: Tests gradient addition when multiple operations are involved and their summation.

methods.name: TestGraphAddGradientsWithInitialValues
methods.description: Checks gradients computation when initial gradient values are provided.

methods.name: TestGraphValidateGradientsNames
methods.description: Ensures names of gradient operations are correctly prefixed and duplicate name generation raises an error.
